# Yash Maurya

> Research Engineer at Scale AI working on AI safety, model evaluation, red teaming, and privacy-preserving machine learning. M.S. in Privacy Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University.

## Canonical content

- [Complete website in plain-text Markdown](https://yashmaurya.com/llms-full.txt): Full profile, all 21 research entries with authors, venues, summaries, figure sources, all news, speaker bio, public reading notes, flashcards, quiz content, and tool descriptions. No JavaScript required.
- [Homepage as Markdown](https://yashmaurya.com/index.md): Profile, research, news, contact links, and speaker bio.
- [Reading as Markdown](https://yashmaurya.com/reading/index.md): Public reading list, writeups, topics, flashcards, and recap questions with answers.
- [Detailed notes](https://yashmaurya.com/reading/notes/frontier-training-methodologies.md): Existing reading summary and explicit draft status for the detailed notes.
- [Speaker bio](https://yashmaurya.com/speaker-bio.txt): Owner-provided third-person biography for event introductions.
- [Structured content](https://yashmaurya.com/data/site.json): Homepage source data and image provenance.
- [Website](https://yashmaurya.com/): Human-readable HTML with stable paper anchors.
